# CLI Reference

<!-- This file is generated by tools/generate_docs_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

The command help below is captured from the installed Noema CLI entry point.

## `noema`

```text
usage: noema [-h] [--version] [--workspace WORKSPACE] [--adapter ADAPTER]
             {ops,data,recipe,template,research,suite,benchmark,submission,adapter,runs,differentiable,dataset-capture,agentic,ui}
             ...

Run learned-communication experiment contracts and inspect protocol-to-plot
evidence.

positional arguments:
  {ops,data,recipe,template,research,suite,benchmark,submission,adapter,runs,differentiable,dataset-capture,agentic,ui}
    ops                 Inspect operation contracts
    data                Fetch or inspect sample datasets
    recipe              Validate, graph, or run recipes
    template            Inspect or instantiate cataloged recipe starters
    research            Inspect research datasets, tasks, and metrics
    suite               Inspect benchmark suites
    benchmark           Inspect or run benchmark packs
    submission          Validate benchmark submission bundles
    adapter             Create and validate external adapter SDK manifests
    runs                Inspect run records
    differentiable      Inspect replacement-to-loss training paths and export
                        training contracts
    dataset-capture     Generate dataset-capture shards from researcher-
                        selected recipe taps
    agentic             Validate, run, replay, or verify agentic supervisory
                        experiments
    ui                  Run the dashboard server

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --workspace WORKSPACE
                        Workspace for datasets, artifacts, and run records.
                        Defaults to .noema.
  --adapter ADAPTER     External adapter manifest or directory to register.
                        May be repeated. NOEMA_ADAPTER_PATHS is also honored.
```

## `noema recipe run`

```text
usage: noema recipe run [-h] [--strict-lint] [--backend BACKEND]
                        [--implementation IMPLEMENTATION]
                        [--parallel-workers N] [--no-plan-cache]
                        path

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --strict-lint         Run strict shared-platform lint checks before
                        execution.
  --backend BACKEND     Require this materialization backend for every recipe
                        step.
  --implementation IMPLEMENTATION
                        Require this materialization implementation for every
                        recipe step.
  --parallel-workers N  Execute independent DAG branches with up to N workers
                        (1-32, default: 1).
  --no-plan-cache       Bypass execution-plan caching for this run.
```

## `noema recipe run-matrix`

```text
usage: noema recipe run-matrix [-h] [--strict-lint] [--continue-on-error]
                               [--backend BACKEND]
                               [--implementation IMPLEMENTATION]
                               [--parallel-workers N] [--no-plan-cache]
                               path

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --strict-lint         Run strict shared-platform lint checks on every
                        concrete variant.
  --continue-on-error   Continue running remaining variants after a variant
                        fails.
  --backend BACKEND     Require this materialization backend for every recipe
                        step.
  --implementation IMPLEMENTATION
                        Require this materialization implementation for every
                        recipe step.
  --parallel-workers N  Execute independent DAG branches with up to N workers
                        per variant (1-32, default: 1).
  --no-plan-cache       Bypass execution-plan caching for every matrix
                        variant.
```

## `noema benchmark run`

```text
usage: noema benchmark run [-h] [--strict-lint] [--backend BACKEND]
                           [--implementation IMPLEMENTATION]
                           [--parallel-workers N] [--no-plan-cache]
                           [--resume FAILED_RESULT_ID] [--retain-backing-runs]
                           [--json]
                           path

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --strict-lint         Require every benchmark recipe to pass strict shared-
                        platform lint.
  --backend BACKEND     Require this materialization backend for every
                        benchmark recipe step.
  --implementation IMPLEMENTATION
                        Require this materialization implementation for every
                        benchmark recipe step.
  --parallel-workers N  Execute independent DAG branches with up to N workers
                        per recipe (1-32, default: 1).
  --no-plan-cache       Bypass execution-plan caching for every benchmark
                        recipe.
  --resume FAILED_RESULT_ID
                        Explicitly resume a failed terminal result. Validated
                        completed recipe evidence is reused; the failed row
                        and remaining rows run with identical pack and
                        execution settings.
  --retain-backing-runs
                        Keep redundant .noema/runs backing directories after
                        their result-local evidence snapshots are verified. By
                        default they are pruned to control benchmark disk
                        usage.
  --json                Emit JSON
```

## `noema benchmark plot`

```text
usage: noema benchmark plot [-h] --plot
                            {graceful-degradation,packet-success,channel-uses}
                            --out OUT [--y-metric Y_METRIC] [--x X_METRIC]
                            [--y Y_METRIC_EXPLICIT] [--group GROUP]
                            [--method-order METHOD_ORDER]
                            [--style {noema,paper,compact}]
                            [--style-config STYLE_CONFIG]
                            [--packet-success-panel] [--outage-markers]
                            [--no-outage-markers] [--json]
                            result_id

positional arguments:
  result_id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --plot {graceful-degradation,packet-success,channel-uses}
                        Plot type to export.
  --out OUT             Output image path. Relative paths are written inside
                        the result bundle.
  --y-metric Y_METRIC   Optional metric id for the y-axis, for example
                        quality.psnr_db or task.accuracy.
  --x X_METRIC          Metric id for the x-axis, for example channel.snr_db.
  --y Y_METRIC_EXPLICIT
                        Metric id for the y-axis, for example quality.psnr_db.
  --group GROUP         Grouping key for curves. Use method, recipe, role, or
                        metric:<metric_id>.
  --method-order METHOD_ORDER
                        Comma-separated method/series order for the legend and
                        curves.
  --style {noema,paper,compact}
                        Built-in plot style preset.
  --style-config STYLE_CONFIG
                        Optional JSON/YAML style override file.
  --packet-success-panel
                        For graceful-degradation plots, add a secondary
                        packet-success panel when the metric exists.
  --outage-markers      Mark outage points on digital cliff plots.
  --no-outage-markers   Disable outage markers.
  --json                Emit JSON
```

## `noema differentiable inspect`

```text
usage: noema differentiable inspect [-h] [--replacement STEP_IDS]
                                    [--loss LOSS]
                                    [--training-plan TRAINING_PLAN] [--json]
                                    path

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --replacement STEP_IDS, --optimizable STEP_IDS
                        Optional comma-separated replacement step ids to
                        inspect against the selected loss. --optimizable is
                        retained as a compatibility alias.
  --loss LOSS           Optional loss/evaluation step id. Defaults to
                        metrics/evaluation steps or terminal steps.
  --training-plan TRAINING_PLAN
                        Optional separate training-plan YAML/JSON overlay; the
                        source recipe remains unchanged.
  --json                Emit JSON
```

## `noema differentiable export`

```text
usage: noema differentiable export [-h] [--training-plan TRAINING_PLAN]
                                   [--replacement STEP_IDS]
                                   [--route-loss ROUTE_LOSS]
                                   [--framework {torch-sionna,torch}] --out
                                   OUT [--force] [--json]
                                   path

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --training-plan TRAINING_PLAN
                        Optional separate training-plan YAML/JSON overlay; the
                        source recipe remains unchanged.
  --replacement STEP_IDS, --optimizable STEP_IDS
                        Comma-separated replacement-target step ids, for
                        example sender,receiver. May instead be supplied as
                        selected_steps in --training-plan; --optimizable is a
                        compatibility alias.
  --route-loss ROUTE_LOSS
                        Optional comma-separated recipe loss/evaluation step
                        ids that define the live downstream support DAG. May
                        instead come from training-plan loss_steps.
  --framework {torch-sionna,torch}
                        Framework requested for support blocks; may instead
                        come from --training-plan.
  --out OUT             Output directory for generated differentiable-export
                        files.
  --force               Overwrite generated files in an existing directory.
  --json                Emit JSON
```

## `noema dataset-capture run`

```text
usage: noema dataset-capture run [-h] [--training-plan TRAINING_PLAN] --out
                                 OUT [--force] [--json]
                                 [--progress | --no-progress]
                                 path

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --training-plan TRAINING_PLAN
                        Separate training-plan YAML/JSON containing the
                        capture taps and split settings.
  --out OUT             Output dataset-capture bundle directory
  --force               Overwrite files in an existing dataset-capture
                        directory
  --json                Emit final JSON and suppress live progress unless
                        --progress is set.
  --progress            Show capture progress on stderr even when it is not a
                        terminal.
  --no-progress         Disable capture progress.
```

## `noema agentic run`

```text
usage: noema agentic run [-h] [--provider PROVIDER] [--model MODEL]
                         [--model-revision MODEL_REVISION]
                         [--endpoint ENDPOINT] [--base-url BASE_URL]
                         [--api-key-env API_KEY_ENV] [--prompt PROMPT]
                         [--device DEVICE] [--out OUT] [--json]
                         path

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --provider PROVIDER   Override the configured decision provider for this
                        recorded campaign
  --model MODEL         Override the model identifier
  --model-revision MODEL_REVISION
                        Override the immutable local-model revision
  --endpoint ENDPOINT   Override the Ollama or compatible HTTP endpoint
  --base-url BASE_URL   Alias for --endpoint for OpenAI-compatible providers
  --api-key-env API_KEY_ENV
                        Dedicated NOEMA_AGENT_* environment variable
                        containing the API key
  --prompt PROMPT       Override the recorded prompt file
  --device DEVICE       Override the local Transformers device, for example
                        cpu
  --out OUT             Campaign output directory; defaults below
                        WORKSPACE/agentic
  --json                Emit JSON
```
